topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the key learning objectives regarding cancer genetics and cellular transformation.

topics.label: Discovery of oncogenes and assays for cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the historical discovery of cellular oncogenes through tumor viruses and the laboratory assays used to test cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional categories of cancer mutations and illustrate their dominant and recessive mechanisms using cell-cycle regulators such as Rb and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defective DNA repair, replication stress, and mitotic errors generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor development and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential somatic and inherited mutations accelerate tumorigenesis and influence tumor progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary review, recommended reading, and a preview of the next session.
